trust_decision.summary: urllib.request decides whether stored credentials (and the prior-auth 'already authenticated' flag) apply to a request URL by comparing the reduced (authority, path) only; the scheme is dropped in reduce_uri, so credentials stored for https:// match the same host over http://.

landing_point.why: The summary names HTTPPasswordMgr and scheme matching; HTTPPasswordMgr.find_user_password is the documented lookup and reduce_uri/is_suburi sit directly below it.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTPPasswordMgr.add_password (public API; also AbstractBasicAuthHandler.add_password alias at Lib/urllib/request.py:933)

HTTPPasswordMgr.find_user_password (public API), reached by HTTPBasicAuthHandler.http_error_401 -> retry_http_basic_auth (Lib/urllib/request.py:983) and HTTPDigestAuthHandler -> get_authorization (Lib/urllib/request.py:1132)
HTTPPasswordMgrWithPriorAuth.update_authenticated (public API; called from AbstractBasicAuthHandler.http_response at Lib/urllib/request.py:1007-1013)
new private helpers _reduce_uri_with_scheme/_is_suburi_with_scheme added next to HTTPPasswordMgr.is_suburi (Lib/urllib/request.py:852)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Lib/urllib/request.py:877-905 (HTTPPasswordMgrWithPriorAuth keeps a separate self.authenticated store keyed by reduce_uri, consumed by AbstractBasicAuthHandler.http_request at Lib/urllib/request.py:994-1005)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about find_user_password returning HTTPS credentials; the prior-auth 'authenticated' flag is a separate boolean store in an opt-in subclass and holds no password, so a solver can argue it needs no scheme scoping (yet leaving it makes http_request still attach an Authorization header, 'Basic None:None' once find_user_password is fixed, which the published test rejects).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: URIs stored without a scheme (bare 'host[:port]' or network-path '//host/') must keep matching any scheme, a bare-authority authuri must still find scheme-scoped credentials (proxy handlers pass req.host), and the public reduce_uri/is_suburi must keep returning/accepting 2-tuples; an over-broad fix (require scheme equality, or change reduce_uri's return shape) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: uri as a single str vs a sequence of URIs (Lib/urllib/request.py:810-811, Lib/urllib/request.py:892-893)
full URI with scheme (https://host/path) vs bare authority 'host[:port]' with no scheme (Lib/urllib/request.py:838-842)
network-path reference '//host/' (urlsplit gives netloc but empty scheme; fix.diff:9643-9648, fix.diff:9714)
implicit default port vs explicit port, both default_port passes (Lib/urllib/request.py:814, Lib/urllib/request.py:844-849)
realm string vs realm None default/prior-auth lookup (Lib/urllib/request.py:869-874, Lib/urllib/request.py:1000)

O7_producer.where: Lib/urllib/request.py:829-850 (reduce_uri builds the stored keys in add_password at Lib/urllib/request.py:814-817 and update_authenticated at Lib/urllib/request.py:895-898; the latter is driven by http_response at Lib/urllib/request.py:1010-1012)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ProxyBasicAuthHandler/ProxyDigestAuthHandler look up by schemeless proxy authority (req.host), so scheme scoping never applies to proxy credentials; by the fix's own rule a schemeless authuri matches any stored scheme.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Proxy auth is a neighbouring feature; the published fix explicitly keeps schemeless authuris matching every scheme, and the proxy's scheme is not the request's scheme.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~140 lines below the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HTTPDigestAuthHandler.http_error_401 passes only the authority (urlparse(...)[1]) as host; a variant where get_authorization used that host instead of req.full_url would silently lose the scheme.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Basic handler already uses a host-or-URL argument and the digest code carries an unused host parameter, so switching the lookup to it is a plausible refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A per-Transport credential cache keyed by host (filled from user:pw@host on an https ServerProxy, reused for a later http ServerProxy to the same host).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Transport already parses userinfo into a Basic header per host and caches connections per host; caching the header per host is a natural convenience and would be a second implementation in another package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HTTPHandler choosing credentials from a host-keyed store regardless of its secure flag.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HTTPHandler already takes credentials and a secure flag separately; a host-keyed lookup is a plausible extension.

O9_family: credential scoping / cleartext transmission of stored credentials (CWE-319, CWE-522): scheme dropped when matching stored auth to request URL

O10_build.language: Python (pure-Python stdlib module; CPython interpreter built from C)
O10_build.toolchain: C compiler + ./configure && make for CPython; or any Python 3.14 running Lib/urllib/request.py
O10_build.project_tests: Lib/test/test_urllib2.py (RequestHdrsTests.test_password_manager* at Lib/test/test_urllib2.py:146 and Lib/test/test_urllib2.py:232; HandlerTests.test_basic_prior_auth_* at Lib/test/test_urllib2.py:1784 and Lib/test/test_urllib2.py:1811), using mock openers, no network

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a scheme comparison only inside find_user_password (or change reduce_uri to return the scheme), leaving HTTPPasswordMgrWithPriorAuth.is_authenticated scheme-blind and/or breaking schemeless matching and the public reduce_uri 2-tuple.

out_of_scope_notes: HTTPRedirectHandler.redirect_request copies all non-content request headers, including a manually added Authorization, across https->http or cross-host redirects (Lib/urllib/request.py:647-654); separate protection, not the password manager.
ProxyHandler adds Proxy-authorization from proxy URL userinfo as a normal (redirectable) header (Lib/urllib/request.py:784-788).
ProxyDigestAuthHandler looks up credentials by the target req.full_url, not the proxy (Lib/urllib/request.py:1132 via Lib/urllib/request.py:1222-1227).
logging.handlers.HTTPHandler sends Basic credentials even when secure=False (Lib/logging/handlers.py:1313-1317); documented separate feature.
